title: Women's Health Screening in Saudi Arabia | KFSHRC
post_text:
Curious what a women's health screening package in Riyadh includes?

KFSHRC offers a 1-day outpatient screening with OB-GYN and physician consultations.
Includes core blood labs, breast and pelvic ultrasound, and a resting ECG.
Pap smear, HPV testing and mammography are done when clinically indicated.
One post-results consultation is included, in person or virtually.

title: Cancer Screening in Saudi Arabia | KFSHRC
post_text:
Curious what an outpatient cancer screening visit in Riyadh involves?

KFSHRC's screening package is an outpatient pathway of about 1 to 2 days.
It starts with a physician-led consultation and an individual risk factor assessment.
Tests are selected by age, sex and risk profile, e.g. bloodwork, tumor markers and imaging.
Includes a written results summary and one follow-up consult, in person or virtual.

title: Men's Health Screening in Saudi Arabia | KFSHRC
post_text:
Planning a men's health checkup? Here's what a 1-day screening in Riyadh covers.

Outpatient package at King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Centre in Riyadh.
Includes urology consult, blood panels, urinalysis, PSA test and a resting 12-lead ECG.
Fasting 8 to 12 hours before the morning blood draw is typically required.
One follow-up consultation to review results, in person or virtually.
